# Outlayr

> Outlayr is an open source mobile expense tracker, budget app, and subscription tracker, made by danestves LLC. You log a purchase by typing one sentence, saying it, or scanning the receipt. Budgets, savings goals, subscriptions, and insights update as you log. Available on the App Store for iPhone (iOS 18 or later) and on Google Play for Android. English, Spanish, Portuguese, and French.

Outlayr, the app by danestves LLC, is not affiliated with Outlayr, Inc. (outlayr.com), a payments company.

## What it does

- Log an expense or income as one sentence ("Spent $42.00 at Costco for Groceries from Chase today"), tapping any word to change it.
- Voice entry: speak the purchase and the fields fill in.
- Receipt scanning: take a photo or pick one from the library; the store, date, total, and every line are read for you.
- CSV import from a bank or another app. Duplicates are skipped; category names that match yours and known merchants are matched to your categories on the phone.
- Category budgets or one overall monthly budget, with carry-over and a projection of where the current pace ends.
- Savings goals with a target date, showing the monthly amount needed and whether you are ahead or behind.
- Accounts for cash, cards, savings, and debts, each in its own currency. Transfers between accounts are not counted as spending.
- Debts with people: money you lent or borrowed, a sale on credit, or a job or purchase you will pay later, with optional payoff plans. One Accounts screen shows what you have and what you owe.
- Installment purchases from buy now, pay later apps such as Cashea and Klarna: the upfront and each cuota, a reminder the day before each one is due, and late fees. An order already in progress can be read from a screenshot of its payment plan.
- 165 currencies. Totals convert to your main currency at the rate from the day each purchase happened.
- Subscriptions and paychecks log themselves on their day, with an optional reminder before each charge.
- Insights: spending by day and by category, income against spending, and net worth over time. The month can start on payday.
- App lock with Face ID or Touch ID on iPhone, or a fingerprint or face on Android.
- On iPhone: Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Spotlight search, and Apple Pay logging through a Shortcuts automation.
- CSV export and full archive export.
- Entries are stored on the phone first and work offline.

## Plans

- Free: logging, budgets, goals, insights, subscriptions, debts, installments, and iPhone widgets. 20 voice, receipt, or payment plan captures every 30 days, 2 accounts, 2 installment apps, 3 people, 2 payoff plans, 2 category budgets, and 1 account currency.
- Outlayr Pro: 500 captures every 30 days, unlimited accounts, installment apps, people, payoff plans, category budgets, and account currencies, sync across devices, receipt photo backup, AI matching on CSV import, web merchant lookup, and 5 app icons on iPhone.
- Pro is billed monthly or yearly, or bought once. US prices: $7.99 a month, $49.99 a year with 7 days free, or $129.99 once. Prices vary by country and the app store shows yours before purchase.

## Privacy

- The ledger is stored on the device. It reaches Outlayr's servers only when you sign in and turn on sync, or use a feature that needs the server (voice entry, receipt scanning, suggestions).
- No ads, no cross-app tracking, and data is never sold. The app sends usage analytics and crash reports to PostHog, never amounts, merchants, or notes.

## Open source

- The code for the app and its server is public on GitHub: https://github.com/danestves/outlayr
- The app (Expo and React Native, for iPhone and Android) is licensed under GPL-3.0. The server (Convex: sign-in, sync, exchange rates) is licensed under AGPL-3.0.

## Connect Outlayr to your AI assistant

- Outlayr has an MCP server for AI assistants. Once you sign in with the account you use in the app and approve the assistant, it can list your recent entries, sum up a month's spending by category, and add entries.
- It reads what your devices have synced, and syncing is part of Outlayr Pro.
- Setup for MCP clients, with the server URL: https://tryoutlayr.com/auth.md

## Guides

- [All guides](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides): every guide in one list
- [AI expense tracker](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/ai-expense-tracker): which words fill the amount, merchant, category, account, date, and currency when you say a purchase, how the typed sentence fills the same fields by tapping, four worked examples, what works offline, and what needs an account. AI reads spoken entries and receipts; the typed sentence is a form
- [How to track expenses](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/how-to-track-expenses): three methods (a spreadsheet, an app, or cash envelopes), how to pick categories, log every expense, review weekly and close the month, the 50/30/20 split, and tracking in more than one currency. Written in Spanish first at https://tryoutlayr.com/es/guides/how-to-track-expenses
- [Best budget apps](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/best-budget-apps): Actual Budget, EveryDollar, Goodbudget, Monarch Money, Outlayr, PocketGuard, Spendee, and YNAB by budget style (envelopes, zero-based, or a limit with a pace), with price, how entries get in, currencies, and platforms, each detail linked to the page it was read on. Outlayr is ours
- [YNAB alternatives](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/ynab-alternatives): Actual Budget, Copilot Money, EveryDollar, Goodbudget, Monarch Money, Outlayr, and PocketGuard by the need each fits, with price, how entries get in, currencies, and platforms, plus how to export from YNAB and which of them take the file. Outlayr is ours
- [Multi-currency and travel expense tracking](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/multi-currency-expense-tracker): 165 currencies, from dollars and pesos to bolívares, the rate from the day of each purchase (Open Exchange Rates, and the BCV rate through Cotizave for bolívares), typing your own rate or the dollar amount you paid, the USDT (Binance) rate for dollar to bolívar transfers, and accounts that each keep their own currency, at home or on a trip
- [Apple Pay logging](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/apple-pay-expense-tracker): how a Shortcuts automation logs each Apple Pay purchase on iPhone
- [Budget planner](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/budget-planner): category or overall budgets by day, week, month, or year, carry-over, where the current pace ends, and a month that can start on payday
- [Best subscription tracker apps](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/best-subscription-tracker-apps): Bobby, Monarch, Outlayr, PocketGuard, and Rocket Money by the need each fits, with price, how entries get in, subscriptions, where each works, and platforms, each detail linked to the page it was read on. Outlayr is ours. Rocket Money's team cancels subscriptions and negotiates bills; Outlayr does neither
- [Best expense tracker apps](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/best-expense-tracker-apps): Monefy, Money Manager, Outlayr, Spendee, Wallet by BudgetBakers, and YNAB by the need each fits, with price, how entries get in, currencies, and platforms, each detail linked to the page it was read on. Outlayr is ours
- [Best open source expense tracker apps](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/best-open-source-expense-tracker-apps): Actual Budget, Cashew, Firefly III, Flow, and Outlayr by the need each fits, with price, how entries get in, currencies, platforms, and license, each detail linked to the page it was read on. Outlayr is ours
- [Mint alternatives](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/mint-alternative): Copilot Money, EveryDollar, Goodbudget, Monarch Money, Outlayr, PocketGuard, Rocket Money, and YNAB by the need each fits, which of them import a CSV, and how to import a Mint CSV export into Outlayr: which rows import on any plan, and how Pro matches the other category names to yours with AI. Outlayr is ours
- [Receipt scanner](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/receipt-scanner): what a scan reads (store, date, total, up to 60 lines, tax, tip, and how you paid), how the category, account, and currency are picked, refunds, invoices and bills, the review before saving, the free and Pro capture limits, and what it needs
- [Subscription tracker](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/subscription-tracker): recurring charges that log themselves, an Upcoming list with what your subscriptions and bills cost per month, and reminders before each charge. Outlayr does not cancel subscriptions for you
- [Expense tracker template](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/expense-tracker-template): a free Excel workbook (Transactions, a Summary with income, spending, and net for the month and currency you pick, spending against a budget per category, and a chart, and How to import) and a plain CSV, both with the columns Outlayr's CSV import reads; rows whose category matches one of yours by name import on any plan, and Outlayr Pro matches the rest with AI, up to 5,000 rows and 2 MB a file. The Spanish page offers a Spanish file: https://tryoutlayr.com/es/guides/expense-tracker-template
- [Voice expense tracker](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/voice-expense-tracker): saying a purchase in English, Spanish, Portuguese, or French, what voice entry fills in, how spoken corrections work, and the 20 free captures every 30 days

## Calculators

- [All calculators](https://tryoutlayr.com/tools): free money calculators that run in the browser; nothing typed is stored or sent
- [50/30/20 budget calculator](https://tryoutlayr.com/tools/50-30-20-budget-calculator): splits take home pay into needs, wants, and savings by 50/30/20, 60/20/20, or 70/20/10, from weekly, two weekly, monthly, or yearly pay
- [Subscription cost calculator](https://tryoutlayr.com/tools/subscription-cost-calculator): what a list of subscriptions costs a month and a year, counting a weekly charge 52 times a year
- [Installment calculator](https://tryoutlayr.com/tools/installment-calculator): the total, the extra over the cash price, and the effective annual rate of an installment or buy now, pay later plan
- [Split expenses calculator](https://tryoutlayr.com/tools/split-expenses-calculator): splits what a group paid equally and lists who pays whom to settle it
- The site's MCP server at https://tryoutlayr.com/mcp runs the same four calculators without signing in, as the tools budget_split, subscription_cost, installment_cost, and split_expenses
